::: {.notes}
The human brain has limitations:

- Iconic memory — pre-cognition; everything comes in and gets processed

- Short-term memory / Miller's Law (7 +/- 2) - George Miller, psychologist in the 1950s

- Long-term memory
:::

# Some [simple tactics]{.emphasis} can [reduce cognitive load]{.emphasis} {background-color="var(--divider-bg)"}

::: {.hollow-square-bullets .incremental}

- Make the point [impossible to miss]{.emphasis}
- Keep the audience's [attention]{.emphasis}
